regex: No keyword with name '(?P<kw>[^']+)' found\.(?: Did you mean:\s*\n(?P<sugg>(?:\s{4}\S.*\n?)+))?
action: fuzzy lookup in imported libs (kwcache) + cross-library alias map; inline best 1-3 signatures

regex: No keyword with name '(?P<kw>[^']+)' found\. Did you try using keyword '(?P<real>[^']+)' and forgot to use enough whitespace
action: remind: >=2 spaces (use 4) between keyword and args; if kw is a SeleniumLibrary name while Browser is imported -> alias map (Click Element -> Click)
inline one-line signature of kw (owner-qualified) + pointer to .rf/docs/kw/<Lib>/<Kw>.md

regex: Argument '(?P<arg>[^']+)' got value '(?P<val>[^']*)' that cannot be converted to (?P<type>[^:.]+)(?:: (?P<detail>.*))?
action: inline signature + allowed values (enum members are in the message already)

regex: 'str' object cannot be interpreted as an integer|got multiple values for argument '(?P<arg>[^']+)'|got an unexpected keyword argument '(?P<kwarg>[^']+)'|Keyword '(?P<kw>[^']+)' got unexpected named argument
action: named arg not accepted -> show signature (names) of last keyword
list defined user vars via .vars --user hint; check assignment line passed
is it installed in THIS venv? (importlib.util.find_spec); never pip install into shared venv; check name spelling/case
paths are relative to the project root robotcode detected (or ${CURDIR}); suggest absolute path / glob for *.resource

regex: has already imported library '(?P<lib>[^']+)' with different arguments\. This import is ignored\.
action: warn: first import's args (e.g. timeout) win for the whole REPL session

regex: TimeoutError: locator\.(?P<op>\w+): Timeout (?P<ms>\d+)ms exceeded\.(?:\s*Call log:\s*\n\s*- waiting for (?P<loc>.+))?
action: page capture + near-miss grep in controls.tsv (frame prefix / shadow) + wait hint

regex: strict mode violation: (?P<loc>.+?) resolved to (?P<n>\d+) elements
action: show the candidates (already in message) + suggest '>> nth=0' or a more specific selector

regex: (?P<what>Element|Button|Link|Image|List|Checkbox|Radio button|Text field|Text area|Frame) with locator '(?P<loc>[^']+)' not found
action: page capture + near-miss grep; iframe -> Select Frame
check URL/base variable; file:// paths need absolute path
assertion failure (not a locator problem): read actual value; don't weaken the assertion in debug tasks
